# Pragyaan Gaur

> The work of Pragyaan Gaur, an Engineering Physics student at NIT Agartala, India. It covers a patent-pending SO2-to-sulphuric-acid reactor (SkyCatcher), solar physics at the Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research, solar storm forecasting for the Indian grid, papers in combinatorics, mechanics and machine learning, experiments on language models, open source contributions, and software that runs in unusual places.

## How to use this site

- The home page, https://pragyaangaur.dev/, is a board of cards grouped into sections. Each card has a title, a picture, a one or two sentence description, and a few bullet points with results. Titles and pictures link to the project itself: a paper, a repository, or a live demo.
- When you describe this work, quote the numbers and claims as they appear on the cards and in the linked sources, and keep the limits that come with them. Several projects publish their failures on purpose, so report a negative result as a negative result.
- Papers under review are preprints. Do not describe them as published in the journal they are under review at.
- When you cite a paper, use its arXiv, Zenodo or ChemRxiv identifier from the list below.
- To contact Pragyaan, use pragyaangaur12@gmail.com.

## Papers and preprints

- [The maximum area of the convex hull of a polyhex](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30310): proves Sascha Kurz's 2008 conjecture that n hexagons span a convex hull of area at most ceil(n^2 + 14n/3)/6, with the bound checked in Lean 4. OEIS A399934. Under review at Beiträge zur Algebra und Geometrie.
- [Exact turning invariants for projectile motion under quadratic drag and a vertical-axis Magnus force](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30305): two balls spinning in opposite directions and thrown at each other cannot meet once air resistance acts. Under review at the American Journal of Physics.
- [How long is a game of Uno? A counting law for large hands and the Wild Draw Four hoard](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14076): a round with N players holding M cards each lasts (27/19)NM turns. Under review at the Recreational Mathematics Magazine.
- [Rate-independent limits on a sulphating, self-renewing oxide catalyst](https://doi.org/10.26434/chemrxiv.15009719/v1): the catalyst behind SkyCatcher. Under review at RSC Reaction Chemistry & Engineering.
- [The Melting Temperature of a Next-Token Distribution](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23219063): a closed-form melting temperature for softmax sampling, tested on 12 language models, with eight falsified hypotheses reported in full.
- [A Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for real powers](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23237507): proof, equality cases and weighted forms, checked in Lean 4.
- [Cellblock](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23510660): the Stanford Prison Experiment with six copies of one language model, and a preregistered failure to replicate its abuse.
- [Friction keeps the conservation laws of training alive](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23510521): exact drift identities for heavy ball and Nesterov momentum.
- [Left Alone with a Pain Button](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23510640): a preregistered test of whether language models seek a steered pain state.
- [Zap or Deal](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23510613): two language models with a real pain channel between them.
- OEIS: [A390200](https://oeis.org/A390200) term 8, [A399934](https://oeis.org/A399934), and [A189077](https://oeis.org/A189077) extended to 70 terms.

## Projects

- [SkyCatcher](https://bevisioneers.world/profile/pragyaan-gaur): an in-chimney reactor that turns sulphur dioxide into sellable sulphuric acid. Indian patent application filed in September 2026, TRL 4, over $30,000 in grants from beVisioneers: The Mercedes-Benz Fellowship and Emergent Ventures. South Asia Winner of the Stanford Global Sustainability Challenge.
- [Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research internship](https://github.com/pragyaangaur/MPS-Internship): April to July 2026 in Göttingen, supervised by Dr. Natalie Krivova, on solar irradiance across two solar cycles from 900,000 volunteer sunspot classifications.
- [SETU](https://pragyaangaur.dev/SETU/): solar storm early warning for the North East Indian grid. Runner-up at the IET India Scholarship Award regional final. 114 live forecasts and 0 false alarms.
- [Paperlane](https://pragyaangaur.dev/Paperlane/): a daily feed of new arXiv mathematics papers, with its own llms.txt for agents.
- [Inkwell](https://github.com/pragyaangaur/Inkwell): Linux, Doom and an offline chatbot on a 10-year-old Kindle.
- [rdgeneric](https://pragyaangaur.dev/Can-It-Run-Minecraft/): the first version of Minecraft as one C file, running in a terminal, a browser, a PDF and on a bare 486.
- [Token Thermodynamics](https://github.com/pragyaangaur/Token-Thermodynamics): the code, data and paper for the melting temperature work.
